title: anim.clinch/1
description: data/anim/clinch.json: the clinch's grip layer (docs/animation/clinch-sizing.md, slice C2; AnimFighter._grip_layer): the sim's hold arrives as a read (partner, kind, role, grade, side) and the layer mixes these poses in. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references in tools/lib/xref-fight.js (anim-clinch-pose: every pose named exists; anim-clinch-held: every held_poses key is a kind of poses).

reach.description: The pose of a hold's read "reach" (a real pose: rule anim-clinch-pose).

seat.description: The pose of a hold's read "seat" (a real pose: rule anim-clinch-pose).

brace.description: The pose of a hold's read "brace" (a real pose: rule anim-clinch-pose).

pin.description: The pose of a hold's read "pin" (a real pose: rule anim-clinch-pose).

carry.description: The pose of a hold's read "carry" (a real pose: rule anim-clinch-pose).

whiff.description: The pose of a hold's read "whiff" (a real pose: rule anim-clinch-pose).

apart.description: The pose of a hold's read "apart" (a real pose: rule anim-clinch-pose).

poses.description: The pose of each kind of a hold.

additionalProperties.description: The pose the held body takes for this kind.

held_poses.description: The pose the held (pinned) body takes, by kind (each key a kind of poses: rule anim-clinch-held).

ramp_ticks.description: Ticks the layer takes to mix a pose in.

gap_budget.description: How much of the gap between the pair the layer may close, in body units.

hand_back.description: How far the hand comes back toward the guard when the hold ends, 0 to 1.

depth_offset.description: How far the holder stands off in depth, in units.
